Name: Zeboim
ModernLocation: Unknown; in Benjamin after the return from exile
Description: Zeboim was a town in Benjamin resettled after the exile, named in Nehemiah's list of dwellers (Nehemiah 11). No further story is attached to it in Scripture, and its exact site is unidentified.
BiblicalSignificance: Its inclusion in Nehemiah's list marks it as one of the towns inhabited after the return from exile.
